title: [BugFix] Resync dp to avoid unreasonable padding in adaptive verification
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
This PR aims to fix unreasonable padding of num_reqs in draft model when enabling adaptive verification. Since vllm skips dp sync in draft model and varlen decode graph uses num_tokens as num_reqs, dspark finally forwards too many tokens with padding than what it is supposed to handle. For example, `num_speculative_tokens=5`, `num_reqs=16`, target model chooses graph with  `graph.num_tokens=96,graph.num_reqs=96`, and finally it causes that draft model processes `96*5=480` tokens instead of `16*5=80` tokens.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
N/A

### How was this patch tested?
by ci

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/ced6857afa0ea7b2e3f0846a62e1394e90f15607
